programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Drevjakt I Vibyholm
programme.desc: Jompen är ute på en minst sagt händelserik drevjakt på Vibyholm i Sörmland. Massa vilt, missa inte!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Kattis Jagar Vildsvin & Toppfågel
programme.desc: Äntligen är Kattis tillbaka i rutan! Vi får följa med på en händelserik drevjakt med mängder av vildsvin. Inte nog med det så blir det jakt med ställande hund på Vildsvin!

programme.title: Vilterian: Burgare & Rygg
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt besöker Jompen Kim Nyström på Slottsholmen där det bjuds på vildsvinsburgare och en svårfångad förrätt.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Drevjakt I Tyskland & Rough Shooting
programme.desc: Jompen är nerbjuden av Steiner till Tyskland på drevjakt. På menyn står vildsvin, rådjur och annat.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Sturefors pyrschjakt
programme.desc: Skovlar överallt i veckans jaktfilm. Danne och Jompen trotsar väder och vind för en riktigt fin smygjakt!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Nixon Och Anders Jagar & Årets Sista Drevjakt
programme.sub-title: Nixon Och Anders Jagar & Årets Sista Drevjakt
programme.desc: Idag blir det både smygjakt och ställande jakt på vildsvin i samma film! Anders åker till Åda i Trosa för riktigt lyckad jakt.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Vi Testar Aimpoint Sikten
programme.desc: Jompen, Danne, Calle och Anders åker ner till Aimpoint i Skåne för att testa rödpunktssikte för första gången. Vad är fördelen med rödpunkt? Bör man byta till rödpunkt för drevjakter? Hur fungerar rödpunkt? Allt detta och mer besvaras.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Björnjakt I Fjällen
programme.desc: Filip ger sig iväg i fjällen på björnjakt. En utmanande och tidskrävande jaktform som väldigt snabbt kan få upp pulsen när björnarna väl dyker upp!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Harjakt I Skåne & Jakt På Kronhjort
programme.sub-title: Harjakt I Skåne & Jakt På Kronhjort
programme.desc: Vi är nere i Skåne och jagar hare och annat småvilt.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Bock Och Duvjakt
programme.desc: Jompen åker till Blommeröd i Skåne för att jaga och käka med matgeniet Calle.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Hela Jompen Och Pierres Jaktgarderob
programme.desc: Jompen och Pierre går igenom alla sina jaktprylar, vapen, kläder, utrustning, you name it!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Jakt I Namibia & Sommarjakt På Vildsvin
programme.sub-title: Jakt I Namibia & Sommarjakt På Vildsvin
programme.desc: Pierre reser till Namibia för jakt på Oryx, Springbock och Red hartebeest. Det blir magiska dagar och många både fina och spännande jaktsekvenser.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Drömpyrsch
programme.desc: Jompen smyger på räv, dovhjort och vildsvin. Fantastisk vacker dag med skare som försvårar Jompens skottmöjligheter.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Ser Älg Men Skjuter Dov!
programme.desc: Vi är inbjudna av ett grymt jaktlag utanför Kisa. Jompen Pierre och Christoffer njuter av jakten och den fantastiska lunchen.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Musikhjälpen & Grisabocken
programme.desc: En av våra kära tittare köpte en jakt med oss via Musikhjälpen. Glada blev vi o alla andra involverande. Vildsvinsjakt va det vi bjussa på.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Drev- Och Gåsjakt I Skåne
programme.desc: Jompen åker till Blommeröd för drevjakt & gåsjakt med Calle Dreyer!

programme.title: Vilterian: Rådjursspett & Bacon Explosion!
programme.desc: Alexander Lundin bjuder Jompen ännu en gång på fantastisk viltmat. Denna vecka blir det rådjursspett med karamelliserade rotfrukter & gräddig lingonsås.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Yakiniku På Vilt & Säljakt
programme.desc: Jompen o Calle brygger öl hos en kompis samtidigt som dom tillagar yakiniku o vårullar på viltkött, närmare bestämt vildsvin o rådjurskött.

programme.title: Vilterian: Dovhjort, Pulled Wildboar & Risotto
programme.desc: Häng med Tottie när han visar hur man grillar en perfekt dovhjort rakt på glöden! Gott, enkelt, rough!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Toppfågeljakt & Jakt På Mufflon
programme.desc: Jompen och Danne åker till Dalarna för att jaga toppfågel. Tyvärr ställer stormen Alfrida till det och de får tänka om. Givetvis fixar Robin biffen.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Småland Drevjakt
programme.desc: Lubbe och Jompen är i Småland på drevjakt. Förmiddagen och dagen blir inte riktigt som dom planerat...

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Två Dagars Drevjakt
programme.desc: Jompen är ute på jaktturne. Drevjakt på vildsvin o dovhjort står på menyn.

programme.desc: 16 Augusti, Bockpremiär. Självklart beger vi oss till Blommeröd för att ta del av magiska jaktupplevelser och kulinariska mästerverk av Carl Dreyer.

programme.title: Vilterian: Köttbullar & Rydberg
programme.desc: Denna vecka lagar Johan Bergquist köttbullar i smarrig tomatsås - på grillen! Detta serveras på en råraka och avnjuts med fördel riktigt kladdig i slaktarpapper!

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Vildsvinsjakt I Skärgården
programme.desc: Jompen är tillbaka på Björkö utanför Loftahammar. En fantastisk drevjakt på vildsvin o dovhjortar.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Ripjakt
programme.desc: Lubbe och Jompen åker till Klimpfjäll i södra Lappland för att jaga ripa.

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt
programme.desc: Skytteträning och andjakt i veckans avsnitt. Jompen och Simon bättrar på sina kunskaper med hjälp av os-medaljören Håkan Dahlby.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Vem är snyggast? Vem spelar dubbelt? Och vem är sugen på vem? Gästerna ställs mot väggen i säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Fear
programme.desc: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: House of Hauntings

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Factory - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean and Bex return to the Factory with guest Kay. Their most haunted investigation ever continues as they uncover secrets of paranormal activity hauntings inside of the Factory. Something dark lurks inside!

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.sub-title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Red Sun Rampant
programme.desc: Japan attacks the USA on 7 Dec 1941. For the next 6 months, they continue to have successful attacks.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.
